$note: RapidAPI is a distribution CHANNEL for the same API. Requests arrive from the RapidAPI proxy carrying X-RapidAPI-Proxy-Secret (validated against the RAPIDAPI_PROXY_SECRET Worker secret; never trusted from a customer directly), X-RapidAPI-User and X-RapidAPI-Subscription. The subscription name maps to the canonical internal plan below. RapidAPI enforces its own monthly quota and billing; the gateway attributes usage to the rapidapi channel and applies the per-minute rate limit as a backstop.

overage.note: Marketplace overage, if ever enabled, is configured per plan in the RapidAPI console. The gateway never bills.
